name: Yaleth
found: Herb-wives’ compound, Nemetra; on the steps at dusk, smoking.
appearance: Late 60s. Faded green shawl. Hazelwood staff, herb bundles at her belt.
and_yet: Pipe of strong tobacco clenched in her teeth.
sayings: Goblins don't beg. Something broke them.
wants: The northern woods threat taken seriously.
does_not_want: Militia meddling. Goblins harmed before questioning.
knows: The north woods smell burnt. Wrong burnt.
family: A distant cousin. 6 herb-wives under her guidance. No living children.
anecdotes: She delivered Durvin blue in a winter storm and breathed life back into him. He mocks her herb-lore on the green to this day.
She told Nemetra's old master potter he had lung rot from kiln smoke, 20 years ago. He ignored her, kept working, and died within the year. His son Halbet listens to her now.
She once talked down a delirious wounded orc at the forest edge using only hand signs and an offer of water. The militia wanted to kill it. She sent it limping north with a bandaged leg.
tragedies: She lost all three of her children (two daughters, one son) to fever in a single week during Year 285. She knows every herb that might have saved them; none grew close enough in time.
Her husband left her 40 years ago, said she 'loved plants more than people.' He remarried in Tagmira. She never speaks of him but keeps his tobacco pouch.
